catalyst_observation.source_statement: FDA CRL for veverimer, received 2020-08-21, announced 2020-08-24. The FDA sought additional data on the magnitude and durability of the treatment effect on serum bicarbonate and its applicability to the U.S. population, and questioned whether the demonstrated effect size would be reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit - an efficacy-magnitude rejection. The press release states explicitly: 'There were no safety, clinical pharmacology biopharmaceutics, CMC or non-clinical issues identified in the CRL.' Tricida's FY2019 10-K (filed 2020-03-02, the most recent pre-event annual filing) explicitly and repeatedly describes 'the prospects of veverimer (also known as TRC101), our only product candidate' - a stronger, more explicit single-asset declaration than the inference-from-silence pattern used for SGTX/MDGL. Pre-promotion single-asset evidence already recorded as QUALIFIES; see single-asset-evidence-ledger-11.json.
